name: cv_upload
description: Upload a PDF CV file and attach the extracted plain text to an existing chat session. The text becomes permanent context for all subsequent RAG queries in that session. Accepts multipart/form-data with a 'file' field. Maximum file size: 10 MB. Scanned (image-only) PDFs without selectable text are rejected with 422. Returns the session ID, character count of extracted text, and a 200-character preview.

session_id.description: UUID of the session to attach the CV to.

file.description: PDF file content as multipart/form-data. Must have content-type application/pdf.
